name: notes-whiteboard-lines
description: Whiteboards keep their line breaks: the Notes panel's read-only agent note renders a three-line note as three visual lines, and the collapsed notes summary keeps a two-line note's breaks but clamps a five-line note to three visible lines, clipping the rest.

mutation.declaration: notespanel.module.css: .prose { white-space: pre-wrap } (deleted); topnotespanel.module.css: .clampedText { white-space: pre-line } and { -webkit-line-clamp: 3 } (each deleted)
mutation.note: Each declaration was deleted separately and re-run on 2026-10-05: without pre-wrap the 3-line agent note renders 1 visual line; without pre-line the 2-line summary renders 1 line and the 5-line summary 2 unclipped lines; without the clamp the 5-line summary shows 5 lines, unclipped.
